answer: Each agent identity must burn a quartz-sealed deposit minted on a bridge from the settlement dune chain: the k-th identity pays a quadratic fee of k² × 2 tokens, so 10 fake agents cost 440 tokens and 100 fake agents cost 686,000 tokens. Deposits are slashed if the identity's proof-of-compute checkpoint misses 2 consecutive epochs, making mass Sybil attack economically ruinous at scale.
